title: Her hands
logline: Chloe's hands around a can of Rainier on the dock, forty-four, a ring gone and its pale band left, the planks, the water. The page the way the strip drew hands: as the whole person.

panels.composition: Close on a woman's hands around a can of beer resting on her knee on a dock, a pale band on one finger where a ring was, the planks and gray water beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a woman's hands around a beer can resting on her knee on a wooden dock with a pale band on one finger where a ring was, planks and gray water beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
